pages.summary: Al salir de la cafetería, la nieve le da a Hermione un momento de calma. Pansy la acompaña antes de buscar el coche.

panels.scene: Two figures leave the small red-brick café, lit glass door and ivy inside, bundled in their familiar coats and gloves. Winter twilight and snow on lamps.
panels.caption: La nieve amortiguaba el ruido de Londres.

panels.scene: Close their naturally drawn gloved hands meet and hold gently, Pansy's black and Hermione's ivory. Black sleeve beside taupe sleeve. Two people and just one hand each in frame.
panels.caption: Caminaron juntas hasta el estacionamiento.

panels.scene: Hermione stops near a lamppost with eyes closed, arms gently open, delighted by falling snow. Pansy a few feet away, still in coat, relaxed.
panels.caption: Hermione se detuvo bajo la nieve.

panels.scene: Pansy watches with a small sincere smile, seen from Hermione's eye level. Green eyes, short black bob with snowflakes on shoulders, no jewelry.
dialogue: Pansy: Me gusta verte así.

panels.scene: Close two distinct profiles at a comfortable distance, Hermione to LEFT and Pansy to RIGHT. Pansy brushes a tiny snowflake from the end of Hermione's scarf with a gloved hand. Two exact speech balloons with clear tails.
dialogue: Hermione: ¿Así cómo?
Pansy: Como si por un momento no tuvieras que preocuparte por nada.

panels.scene: They turn toward the quieter street with gloved hands held once, lamp post and café behind them. Hermione at right turns and speaks to the other woman.
dialogue: Hermione: Vamos antes de que el auto quede enterrado.

pages.summary: Hermione le entrega a Pansy las llaves y prepara el coche para el regreso. Pansy acepta conducir.

panels.scene: Same rounded black coupé stands parked with dusting of fresh snow, headlights off. Hermione calls to Pansy across the roof, both in exact coats.
dialogue: Hermione: Pansy.

panels.scene: Hermione hands the small ring of keys to Pansy beside the car, one gloved hand each. Pansy looks genuinely surprised.
dialogue: Pansy: ¿Me estás dejando conducir el Porsche de tu padre?

panels.scene: Hermione gives the snow-dusted front tire a small flick with a slender dark wand and puts it away. Soft trace of light hugs the tire, unobserved by other people.
dialogue: Hermione: Será más fácil conducirlo así.

panels.scene: Pansy holds up the keys and tilts her head at Hermione, her own car door behind her. Hermione smiles with a mixture of nerves and trust.
dialogue: Pansy: Creo que ya superamos la etapa de la consideración.

panels.scene: Hermione at LEFT, Pansy at RIGHT of frame by passenger and driver doors respectively, shot straight from directly BEHIND the car looking forwards. Arms and reflections ordinary.
dialogue: Hermione: Entra antes de que recupere el sentido común.

panels.scene: Close through the parked vehicle’s RIGHT side driver window. Pansy’s natural gloved hand rests lightly on top of her one dark wheel, recognizable face in three-quarter profile. Hermione seated in far side, both belt lines. Camera sees side windows, no frontal windshield.
panels.caption: Pansy se acomodó al volante.

pages.summary: Pansy se familiariza con el coche de Malcolm. Hermione la acompaña mientras salen de Londres.

panels.scene: Parked car, close of Pansy in the driver seat by the right-side window with the one wheel in front of her. Hermione recognizable beyond her, gives a calm instruction in general terms.
dialogue: Hermione: Tiene un carácter distinto al de la camioneta.

panels.scene: Close Pansy listens, black bob in dashboard light, hands relaxed and separate, both in their seatbelts, no other person in foreground.
dialogue: Pansy: Las instrucciones tuyas suelen tener prioridad.

panels.scene: Exterior three-quarter rear from the street, the same black coupe's lights glow at dusk and car starts gently under a row of warm streetlamps. Snow only off the cleared roadway.
panels.caption: El motor cobró vida.

panels.scene: Side view toward driver Pansy inside at a red light, grin with brownish dashboard reflection on her green eyes. She looks at the road. Hermione on the opposite seat.
dialogue: Pansy: Utilicé la intermitente sin que tuvieras que recordármelo.

panels.scene: Hermione sits belted in passenger seat, warm ivory scarf and chestnut curls pulled back, a sincere amused smile. No steering wheel or driver pose in this closeup.
dialogue: Hermione: Muy bien. Estoy orgullosa de ti.

panels.scene: Wide three-quarter side and rear view as the low black coupe leaves streets for a road bordered by snowy hedges. Low blue sky, ordinary movement.
panels.caption: Las luces de Londres quedaron atrás.

pages.summary: Hermione reconoce en Pansy la misma concentración de cuando vuela. La tormenta empieza a ganar fuerza al llegar a casa.

panels.scene: Rear three-quarter view of black coupé following the left side of a quiet cleared lane, long view of snow-covered hedges. No other vehicle beside it.
panels.caption: Tomaron el desvío entre los árboles nevados.

panels.scene: Side window view, Pansy on right driver position with black bob and concentration, her single steering wheel directly ahead, gaze stays on road. One ordinary smile.
dialogue: Pansy: Admite que soy buena en esto.

panels.scene: Close Hermione in the opposite passenger seat, belted, ivory scarf and brown eyes, amused and thoughtful. No wheel in this frame.
dialogue: Hermione: Te concentras igual que cuando juegas quidditch.

panels.scene: Wide snowy residential street and the familiar illuminated honey-brick home. The black coupe quietly turns into its driveway, neither woman visible outside.
panels.caption: Al llegar al vecindario, la tormenta ganó fuerza.

panels.scene: In the attached garage, stopped black car at an angle from its right side, one open door. Pansy stays seated at the right-hand wheel for a moment. Hermione visible across the center console.
dialogue: Pansy: Estoy despidiéndome.

panels.scene: Hermione at LEFT near the front of the car, Pansy at RIGHT as she steps out. Both back in their winter coats and normal proportions, single set of keys in Pansy's hand, friendly expressions.
dialogue: Hermione: Va a seguir aquí mañana.
